title: CommerceGen-Studio: An End-to-End Framework for Commercial-Grade Main-Image Generation
authors: Xiaoli Xu, Zhengtao Wu, Zhengze Xu et al.
abstract: We present CommerceGen-Studio, an end-to-end framework for generating commercial-grade main images for e-commerce Stock Keeping Units (SKUs). Our framework is organized along a three-stage pipeline of information extraction, semantic rewriting, and multi-condition generation: Prompt-Eval-Refine-Loop Agent (PERL-Agent) distills heterogeneous SKU metadata into concise selling-point text lists through an iterative closed loop of VLM and LLM roles scored by a reference-free rubric.
